title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 100
paragraphs: When the Greeks had completed all their preparations, they proceeded to attack the barbarians. As they went forward, a rumor came suddenly to their whole army, and at the same time a herald's staff was found lying on the beach; the rumor went through the army to this effect — that the Greeks were fighting in Boeotia and conquering the army of Mardonius. By many signs is the divine power seen in earthly things, and by this too: that now, when the day of the defeat at Plataea and of the one about to happen at Mycale chanced to be the same, a rumor came to the Greeks here, so that the army was much more encouraged and more eager to face the danger.
